guest.migrateImportDesc: Your local schedule is empty. Do you want to copy your account activities to this device?

backup.title: Backups
backup.intro: Jikan keeps automatic local backups on this device (no internet needed).
backup.restoreIntro: Restoring adds the backup activities to your current schedule; nothing is deleted.
backup.restoreConfirm: Add the {count} activities from the {when} backup to your schedule?
backup.restoreEmpty: That backup has no valid activities

backup.errFormat: This file is not a valid Jikan backup
backup.errVersion: This backup comes from a newer version of the app
backup.cloudIntro: Upload backups to Google Drive to keep them off this device.
backup.cloudExpired: Your Google Drive session has expired: connect again
backup.cloudNeedConnect: Connect your Google Drive account to use cloud backups
backup.cloudRestoreConfirm: Add the activities from this backup to your current schedule?
backup.cloudRestoreSuccess: Restored the activities from the backup
backup.cloudConfirmDelete: Delete this backup from Google Drive?
backup.cloudOffline: No internet connection: cloud backup is unavailable
backup.cloudNotConfigured: Cloud backup is unavailable: Google Drive is not configured

privacy.intro: Choose which Jikan data is kept on this device.
privacy.offHint: It is not written to the device nor synced. Data already stored is dropped the next time you save.
privacy.encryptionIntro: Encrypts your whole local schedule (titles, descriptions, notes, colors, days and times) with a key derived from your passphrase. Without it the data cannot be read.
privacy.encryptionLocked: Locked: enter your passphrase to unlock.

encryption.lockIntro: Your local schedule is encrypted. Enter your passphrase to continue.
encryption.lockHint: The passphrase is never stored: if you lose it, the data cannot be recovered.
encryption.forgetWarning: If you do not remember the passphrase, the encrypted local data cannot be recovered. It will be deleted from this device and Jikan will start from scratch.
encryption.passphraseTooShort: The passphrase must be at least {min} characters
encryption.notSupported: This browser does not support local encryption
encryption.enableDescription: Choose a passphrase of at least {min} characters. It encrypts your whole local schedule and your local backups; it cannot be recovered if you forget it.
encryption.changeDescription: Enter the current and the new passphrase. Data and local backups are re-encrypted with the new one.
encryption.disableDescription: Confirm your passphrase to store your local schedule unencrypted on this device again.

pwa.intro: Install Jikan to open it as an app and use it offline.
pwa.installedApp: Jikan is already installed on this device.
pwa.manualInstall: Use “Add to Home Screen” in the browser menu to install it.
